messages:
Anya: quick q — for the new priority-routing config should we have a first-class 'dry-run' mode that only emits telemetry but doesn't change routing? i.e. safe rollout without any traffic impact. link: https://rwd/boards/PR-432 :eyes:
Sam: i like that. we should also clarify sampling semantics. dry-run could be full-sample for small cohorts (beta) but sampled for global. would want p95/p99 and route.miss_rate to show impact.
Morgan: API convo: do we add a separate endpoint /config/preview or add an "effect" field to the apply API? Prefer single contract: POST /configs {effect: "apply|dryrun|shadow", sample_rate, targets}. keeps clients simpler.
Kevin: main worry = quota and burst. even dry-run can generate quota-like metrics if we simulate cost. need a flag to disable simulated quota decrement and a telemetry-only marker so billing doesn't see it.
Riley: console UX: preview should show an estimated token cost and a small sample of routed decisions (anonymized). toggle: "simulate quota impact" so PMs can estimate cost.
Anya: +1 to single contract. also want automatic rollback triggers if telemetry delta > threshold during canary (e.g., route.miss_rate + latency_p95).
Sam: proposal for telemetry signals: ["route.success_rate","route.miss_rate","backend.latency_p95","quota.exhaustion_rate","cost.estimate_per_minute"]. default alert deltas: 5% for miss_rate, 10% for latency_p95.
Morgan: sketch of config payload:
```
{
  "flag": "priority_routing.v2",
  "effect": "dryrun",
  "sample_rate": 0.02,
  "targets": ["cohort:beta"],
  "simulate_quota": false
}
```
Use effect=shadow for mirrored traffic that actually routes but duplicates responses to analysis pipeline. dryrun = no routing, just telemetry. shadow = real route + duplicate.
Kevin: ops concern: even shadowing can double backend QPS. we need a built-in throttle cap and an opt-in for shadow. add server-side cap: "shadow_max_qps": 50.
Riley: on console: show a diff view: "what will change" + sample rows (user id hash -> new route). Hover to reveal rationale. Keep preview fast by reusing prefix cache lookups.
Anya: who takes ownership? Kevin — server + caps. Morgan — API contract + docs. Riley — console preview bits. Sam — telemetry/alert rules. I'll wire up a short 1-hour sync to align.
OpsBot: canary-runner: started preview check (dryrun) for priority_routing.v2 on cohort:beta — 10000 samples queued.
Sam: FYI when doing telemetry-only runs please tag metrics with `runmode=dryrun` and `preview_id=<uuid>` so dashboards can filter.
Morgan: agree. also add /configs/validate endpoint that returns estimated impact (tokens/min, estimated error delta) without creating preview. clients can call that before posting.
Kevin: I'll PR server change today. plan: enforce `simulate_quota=false` by default for dryrun and require explicit `simulate_quota=true` + admin role to allow.
Riley: console mock posted: https://figma/r/wire/preview-PR432 — includes sample table + cost estimate.
Anya: sgtm. next steps: Kevin PR, Morgan API spec, Sam alert runbooks, Riley console mock. meet 30m after PRs land to sanity check. :thumbsup:
Kevin: noted. will ping when ready.
Morgan: I'll draft API doc and open swagger with examples.
Anya: thanks all — excited to get safer rollouts for routing config. :party:
